verbatim_quote.original: GROUND your plan in it and cite file paths with lines.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: GROUND your plan in it and cite file paths with lines.

extracted_decision.summary: Manager requires the final plan to be grounded in the discovery report and to cite file paths with line numbers.
extracted_decision.rationale: To enforce evidence-based architectural decisions and traceability.
alternatives: Allow uncited plans based on general knowledge
Permit citations only at a high level
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Slower to produce but higher confidence; May be difficult if discovery report lacks exact line numbers
